title: Only the grader of record confirms a gain
statement: Count a gain or certify work only on the grader of record in its current version; stand-in judges, older versions and self-evaluation are design evidence only.
example: One AP item type's jump from 0.29 to 0.95 existed only under a discredited judge.
detail: When the AP project's binding grader failed with an API key error, the project used a substitute model judge for internal go or no-go decisions but held its final claim for the binding grader. A reported jump for one item type from 0.29 to 0.95 existed only under a discredited judge; one synthesis says it collapsed to about 28% on the binding grader, and the other that the binding grader's confirmation was blocked. Either way, the grader of record never confirmed it. Before counting a gain, check that the fix improves the item rather than dodging the check: one multiple-choice fix worked by removing the source so the grader's leak probe was skipped.
against: The two same-day syntheses disagree on whether the binding grader ever scored the jump, and both elsewhere put the 28% down to harness bugs, so the collapse figure is not settled; only the rule that the jump doesn't count is. The binding grader's own 28% was later put down to four harness bugs (`grade3-reading/artifacts/alpha-read-packager/FACTS_SHEET.md`), so the refutation rests on the jump appearing only under the discredited judge, not on that figure.
